mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects monetary easing that lowers discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it signals a tight monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity attractiveness.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with a declining industrial production index (INDPRO) signals an economic contraction that increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% over 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a high employment level (PAYEMS > 130000 thousand) signals continued economic strength and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high PAYEMS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 over the past 3 months is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it signals a supply shock that reduces corporate profitability.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in INDPRO decline periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 570 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 570 thousand and 395,000 million, respectively, signals robust consumer demand that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in robust demand periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 signals an imminent supply shock that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in supply-constrained periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
